candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable after ~2s; order returns 503 and gateway times out on /v1/orders, surfacing 502s on /v1/checkout. Inventory and payment succeed, isolating the fault to the order-to-postgres path.
